description: Estimate cost for Topaz, FLUX, Runway Magnific, or LTX 2.5 video upscaling.

creativity.description: FLUX creativity (0 precise / 1 creative, default 1) or Runway creativity (0..100, default 20).
creativity.title: Creativity

model.description: Video upscale model: topaz-video-upscale (topaz), flux-video-upscale (flux), runway-video-upscale (runway/magnific), or ltx25-video-upscale (ltx25).
model.title: Model

source_video_id.description: ID of your completed video generation to upscale.
source_video_id.title: Source Video Id

target_fps.description: Target FPS for Topaz Video AI. Legacy mode (without topaz_task/topaz_model/topaz_options): 30 (default) or 60. Topaz fal.ai Precision mode (any of the 21 Precision models, default 'Proteus'): optional 16..60; omit or pass null to preserve source FPS without interpolation.
target_fps.title: Target Fps

target_resolution.description: Target resolution: Topaz Video fal.ai 720p/1080p/2k/4k (omit when using topaz_options.upscale_factor), legacy Topaz 1080p/4k (default 1080p), Runway 720p/1k/2k/4k (default 2k), LTX 2.5 1080p/4k/8k (default 4k). Alias: 'resolution'.
target_resolution.title: Target Resolution

topaz_model.description: Optional Topaz Video fal.ai Precision model variant (default 'Proteus' when topaz_task/topaz_options is set). 21 Precision models across families: Proteus ('Proteus', 'Proteus Natural' [2× only]), Iris ('Iris', 'Iris Low Quality' — faces), Dione ('Dione DV', 'Dione TV', 'Dione Robust', 'Dione Dehalo', 'Dione Robust Dehalo' — deinterlacing), Artemis ('Artemis High Quality', 'Artemis Medium Quality', 'Artemis Low Quality', 'Artemis Strong Halo', 'Artemis Medium Halo', 'Artemis Aliasing & Moire' — denoise/sharpen/dehalo/moire), Gaia ('Gaia HQ', 'Gaia CG', 'Gaia 2' [2× only, animation]), Rhea ('Rhea' — maximum detail), and Theia ('Theia Fine Tune Detail', 'Theia Fine Tune Fidelity'). 'Proteus Natural' and 'Gaia 2' accept only upscale_factor=2. Omit along with topaz_task and topaz_options to keep legacy Replicate Topaz behavior (is_hold=true).
topaz_model.title: Topaz Model

topaz_options.description: Optional Topaz Video fal.ai Precision parameters: upscale_factor (1..4; fixed 2 for 'Proteus Natural' and 'Gaia 2' — other explicit factors are rejected before charge), target_fps (16..60; omit or pass null to keep source FPS), and enhancement knobs noise (0..1), compression (0..1), halo (0..1), grain (0..0.1 step 0.01), recover_detail (0..1). Outputs H.264 MP4.

topaz_task.description: Optional Topaz Video fal.ai task ('upscale', 'interpolate', 'deblur', 'denoise'). Passing any of topaz_task, topaz_model, or topaz_options with model='topaz-video-upscale' routes to Topaz Video fal.ai with fixed upfront pricing (is_hold=false) for calibrated models.
topaz_task.title: Topaz Task

upscale_factor.description: Upscale factor for FLUX Video Upscale: 1.5, 2.0 (default), or 3.0.
upscale_factor.title: Upscale Factor

video_url.description: Owned video key or URL from POST /api/v1/uploads or your own generation.
video_url.title: Video Url

name: estimate_video_upscale
